decorative_orbital_overlay.description: Fake orbital/radar/sonar circular lines used as atmosphere.
decorative_orbital_overlay.reason: Repeated AI-builder motif with no semantic value.
decorative_orbital_overlay.correction: Use image, typography, material, color, or functional diagram instead.

unreadable_floating_navigation.description: Creative or floating navigation placed over images, giant type, or changing backgrounds without readability protection.
unreadable_floating_navigation.reason: Navigation contrast depends on a lucky crop or scroll position.
unreadable_floating_navigation.correction: Use safe placement, scrim, blur, quiet surface, adaptive inverse text, position shift, contextual collapse, or non-overlapping placement.

forced_brand_chrome.description: Logo, app name, initials badge, or wordmark added from template habit.
forced_brand_chrome.reason: Migi often wants identity in the composition rather than persistent top chrome.
forced_brand_chrome.correction: Justify brand chrome in the visual spec or remove it.

decorative_hairline_filler.description: Tiny separator rules, red hairlines, label rails, or ticks added as fake editorial detail.
decorative_hairline_filler.reason: Ornamental lines add no structure and repeat across generated pages.
decorative_hairline_filler.correction: Use real hierarchy, spacing, image crop, color field, or meaningful content boundaries.

cut_off_mobile_sheet.description: Modal, drawer, or bottom sheet is placed too low, clipped by the viewport, hides actions, ignores safe areas, or cannot scroll long content.
cut_off_mobile_sheet.reason: A clipped sheet breaks mobile product usability before visual taste is evaluated.
cut_off_mobile_sheet.correction: Use max-height, internal scroll, safe-area padding, visible/sticky actions, reachable close control, and spatial separation from bottom nav.

overlapping_control_indicator.description: Underline, active bar, progress strip, or selected indicator overlaps a button, chip, tab, nav item, or segmented-control label.
overlapping_control_indicator.reason: Control decoration that crosses content looks broken and reduces readability.
overlapping_control_indicator.correction: Move the indicator outside the label zone or use active background, border, icon, color shift, or separate progress area.

non_persistent_selection.description: Chips, tabs, object selectors, category buttons, or segmented controls look selectable but do not visibly preserve selected state.
non_persistent_selection.reason: Users cannot understand the committed state or product behavior.
non_persistent_selection.correction: Persist selected state until changed, separate hover/pressed/focus/selected states, and bind state to actual UI behavior.

text_only_bottom_nav.description: Practical mobile product bottom navigation uses labels without meaningful icons.
text_only_bottom_nav.reason: Text-only bottom nav is slower to scan and feels less like a polished mobile product.
text_only_bottom_nav.correction: Use a consistent semantic icon family, icon plus label for each destination, and active state on both icon and text.

add_card_masquerades_as_content.description: Add/create affordance is styled like a normal content or object card.
add_card_masquerades_as_content.reason: Users may confuse a creation action with an existing item.
add_card_masquerades_as_content.correction: Use plus/create affordance, dashed action surface, distinct CTA row, floating action button, or separate add module.

random_domain_palette.description: Palette looks cool in isolation but does not fit product domain, user environment, task pressure, emotional state, or state color semantics.
random_domain_palette.reason: Color becomes arbitrary styling instead of product communication.
random_domain_palette.correction: Define Domain Palette Fit before tokens: domain, environment, pressure, emotion, state colors, and random palette rejected.

sepia_archive_brown_wash.description: Muddy sepia, espresso, umber, tobacco, parchment, or brown-black archive wash used as a page, stage, card, panel, sidebar, nav, or framed object background.
sepia_archive_brown_wash.reason: Migi has explicitly rejected this recurring generated-app palette. It makes unrelated projects feel like the same nocturne/archive/botanical template.
sepia_archive_brown_wash.correction: Remove the brown-black surface family. Use an authored palette from the concept or references, such as ink blue, aubergine-black, deep green-black, mineral grey, true black/cream, or another contrast-tested system.

placebo_navigation.description: Navigation, tabs, filters, or segmented controls change active visual state but do not change visible content, route, scope, filter, or product state.
placebo_navigation.reason: Navigation becomes theater and breaks trust.
placebo_navigation.correction: Every selected state must map to a visible product-state change; remove, disable, or mark unimplemented destinations.

map_label_collision.description: Map, floor-plan, seating-chart, timeline, or canvas labels are covered by objects, cards, glows, badges, or controls.
map_label_collision.reason: Spatial labels carry orientation and meaning; covering them breaks the product model.
map_label_collision.correction: Reserve label safe zones, define object collision rules, and keep labels on protected layers.

primary_object_buried_by_cards.description: The product's main object, such as a map, floor plan, timeline, canvas, roster, or queue, is buried under support cards/panels.
primary_object_buried_by_cards.reason: Desktop command surfaces need a central object; cards should support, not replace it.
primary_object_buried_by_cards.correction: Name the primary object and build support panels around it as inspector, queue, controls, and metrics.

dark_dashboard_regression.description: A product surface collapses into generic dark dashboard/card soup instead of a domain-specific command surface.
dark_dashboard_regression.reason: It erases product specificity and makes unrelated tools feel the same.
dark_dashboard_regression.correction: Use domain palette fit, primary-object hierarchy, varied support panels, and real interaction state.

clipped_primary_text.description: Important headings, labels, buttons, or chart/canvas text are visibly cut off by line-height, masks, parent overflow, transforms, sticky containers, or viewport framing.
clipped_primary_text.reason: Readable language is the baseline of visual quality; partial clipping makes the UI feel untested and unfinished.
clipped_primary_text.correction: Fix line-height, padding, overflow, transform origin, responsive height, and text role. Change the layout if the text cannot fit.

catastrophic_diagram_overlap.description: Labels, badges, callouts, measurement chips, selected outlines, ruler text, construction lines, and objects collide until a graph/diagram/canvas becomes unreadable.
catastrophic_diagram_overlap.reason: The product object itself becomes untrustworthy because spatial meaning, measurement, and selected state are visually broken.
catastrophic_diagram_overlap.correction: Use coordinate, layer, object, label-lane, callout-route, badge-safe-zone, and collision models before implementation.

performance_hostile_diagram_canvas.description: Diagram or canvas surfaces repeat heavy shadows, filters, glows, dense DOM/SVG layers, or layout-bound interactions with no rendering budget.
performance_hostile_diagram_canvas.reason: Interactive spatial products must feel immediate; janky pan, zoom, drag, hover, or selection is product failure.
performance_hostile_diagram_canvas.correction: Choose SVG, Canvas/Konva, D3, or React Flow deliberately; limit expensive effects, throttle interaction work, precompute layout, and document a performance budget.
